market_outlook.short_term: Elevated volatility expected. US-Iran strikes and oil rally create inflationary pressure, reinforcing higher-for-longer rates. 10Y at 19-month high pressures growth equities and crypto. Yen at 160 risks BOJ intervention. Cramer's 'shroud' warning and summer-to-volatility transition suggest 5-10% drawdown risk within 60 days. EM momentum (best August since 2004) provides partial offset. Healthcare and AI infrastructure are relative outperformers.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle remains intact with Nvidia as anchor into 2027. Healthcare M&A and GLP-1 spillover create structural consumer rotation. CRE distress may peak in 2027 as multifamily stabilizes. EM/China banking stabilization supports global growth. Rate normalization path depends on oil trajectory and Fed/Warsh hawkishness. 12-month view: cautious constructive with 8-12% equity upside if oil stabilizes below $90 and Fed holds.
